plan.problem: Reference-statistics caching improved 3000/512 timing but pipes mean SSIM fell. Validate the existing cache at default-quality step/resolution settings before considering default integration.
plan.change: No engine code change. Same saved binary and 256 MiB reference-statistics budget; only cache off/on differs.
plan.acceptance: All outputs valid, timing improved and no scene mean PSNR decrease beyond 0.2 dB or SSIM decrease beyond 0.005. These are conservative screening thresholds, not a statistical noninferiority claim. Retain all results, including failing scenes. The app normally trains all photos; this comparison keeps the holdout split.
plan.measurement: Twelve serial runs, alternating A/B and B/A per repetition. Includes process startup, first cache fill, training, evaluation and export. Frozen SfM; no new SfM or API end-to-end timing. Do not upscale TUM images to 1024.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, including per-process first reference-statistics cache population. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
memory_scope: Logical cached reference mean/variance tensor storage only; not allocator capacity or peak process/GPU memory.

references.title: Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity
references.use: Reference local mean and variance depend only on a fixed reference image; only prediction-dependent terms must change each step.

references.title: fused-ssim
references.use: Recent public implementation combines local statistics and supports Metal/MPS. This patch uses existing Burn convolutions and caches fixed reference statistics; no upstream fused kernels are copied.

references.title: Faster-GS (CVPR 2026)
references.use: Motivates matched quality/budget comparisons for implementation changes; CUDA paper speedups are not used as local Metal results.

validation.previous_gpu_numeric_test: Passed in 305e826; unchanged binary reused, not rerun this round.

browser.observations: Models load and drag correctly; fine pipes, cables and text remain blurred, with holes and stretched or floating fragments away from captured views.

raw_metric_scope: raw_runs.evaluation and raw_runs.summary use native Brush evaluation dimensions/implementation. Only aligned_comparisons and summary use common-512 RGB metrics and drive screening.

decision: Do not enable reference-statistics caching by default: pipes fails the predeclared quality screen despite faster mean timing. Official engine unchanged. Keep all runs; investigate inline variance reconstruction from cached second moments as a new hypothesis, not an established cause or fix.
